% Pattern: attach/ref. A proof titled with a reference command of a
% package, as \refeq of mathtools, proves what the label names. Seen in the
% gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{mathtools}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}

\begin{theorem}\label{t:main}
Every bounded monotone sequence converges.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}\label{l:sup}
A bounded set of reals has a least upper bound.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
This is the completeness axiom.
\end{proof}

\section{The proof of the theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem \refeq{t:main}]
Take the least upper bound of the terms.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
